What is FreeQrly?
FreeQrly is a free QR code generator with a simple idea: the tool should live in your browser, not on somebody's server. You type, it draws — nothing is uploaded, tracked, or billed.
100% browser-basedEvery code is drawn locally with JavaScript. Your links, contacts, and WiFi passwords never leave your device.
Codes that never expireStatic codes live in the pattern itself; dynamic codes stay editable after printing. No trials, no deactivated codes — what you print today scans in ten years.
Free to startStatic codes need no account at all. Dynamic codes — editable, with scan stats — need a free sign-in. No watermark either way.
10 languagesEnglish, Chinese, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic (RTL), Portuguese, French, Russian, German, Japanese.
Built for printHigh-resolution export and vector SVG, quiet zones respected — made for business cards, menus, and posters.
Agent-friendlyA free API and MCP server so AI assistants can generate codes too.

What is FreeQrly?
FreeQrly is a free online QR code generator. It creates static QR codes for links, text, WiFi, vCards, SMS, calls, and locations — entirely in your browser, with no account and no fees.
Yes. Every feature — including logo upload, batch generation, and high-resolution export — is free with no trial and no watermarks. Static codes need no account; dynamic codes need a free sign-in.
Do FreeQrly QR codes expire?
No. Static codes encode the destination directly in the pattern, and dynamic codes stay live and editable — neither kind expires or requires a subscription.
Does FreeQrly track my QR codes or my data?

Static codes are generated locally in your browser; their content is never uploaded and they have no scan tracking. Dynamic codes count scans — that is what they are for — and their destinations can be changed anytime.
What languages does FreeQrly support?
Ten: English, Chinese, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic (with right-to-left layout), Portuguese, French, Russian, German, and Japanese.
